answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work with a spiritual emphasis, the strongest options from your results are **Jung Platform’s “Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work”**, **ManTalks’ “Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential,”** and **Kaedrich’s “Shadow School.”** These appear to offer the most clearly structured, transformation-oriented approaches, while Udemy and DailyOM provide more accessible, lower-commitment alternatives.[4][16][7][19]

A practical way to choose is:

- **Best for Jungian depth and theory:** **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** on Jung Platform, which is explicitly positioned as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work.[4][10]
- **Best for a guided spiritual/self-development process:** **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** from ManTalks, described as an 8-week guided process for facing and integrating your shadow.[16]
- **Best for intensive initiation-style work:** **Shadow School** by Kaedrich, a 9-week online shadow work initiation focused on transmuting wounds into power, purpose, and sovereignty.[7]
- **Best budget-friendly option:** **The Shadow Work Method to Heal** on DailyOM, which is shorter and lower-cost than many multi-week programs.[19]
- **Best for broad access and flexibility:** Udemy options such as **Shadow Work Essentials** and **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self Certification**, which are easier to sample and often more affordable.[6][1]

If your goal is specifically **shadow work plus spiritual practice**, the most relevant course descriptions are the ones that explicitly mention **spiritual transformation**, **awakening spiritually**, or **integration with compassion and awareness**.[1][11][3]

Here’s a simple shortlist by use case:

| Best for | Course | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| Depth / Jungian framework | Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work | In-depth intro to Jungian shadow work[4][10] |
| Guided transformation | Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential | 8-week guided integration process[16] |
| Spiritual initiation | Shadow School | 9-week initiation focused on power, purpose, sovereignty[7] |
| Affordable entry point | The Shadow Work Method to Heal | Shorter, lower-cost option[19] |
| Flexible self-paced learning | Shadow Work Essentials / Udemy courses | Broad access and multiple shadow-work techniques[6][1] |

If you want, I can also rank these by **best for beginners**, **best for spiritual practice**, or **best value for money**.
